message: ウェイトレス

name: Nanaka
message: 「How do you like that!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaoo... This isn't how it was supposed to go, nya...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's what you get for underestimating the service industry! Learned your lesson yet!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, stop causing a scene now」

name: Helena
message: 「Why don't you tell us why you targeted the Crusaders?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Guh... Fine, nya, I'll surrender gracefully, nya...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, you should've just done that from the start」

name: Pasta
message: 「Just kidding, nyaaa!」

name: Pasta
message: 「If you think Pasta would give in that easily, you're dead wrong, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I quit this stupid part-time job right now, nyaaa!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, she ran away!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya-ha-ha-ha! You'd better remember this, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「For the sake of Bylous-nyama's love, Pasta will never, ever give up, nyaaa!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What a shameless turnaround...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh dear, she got away from us」

name: Synn
message: 「'Lord Viras'... what kind of magic spell is that?」

name: Ria
message: 「So that's why they want to eliminate the Crusaders, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Could there be a mastermind pulling the strings behind the Demon Generals...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That would mean they are the true Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gasp!」

name: Helena
message: 「I don't think those girls have that level of organizational skill, though」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, as long as we quell Re-Crea, there won't be any problem」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Either way, the peace of Prier has been protected, right!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though to be honest, it ended up looking like we forced her out」

name: Helena
message: 「What should we do about a waitress, I wonder」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's true that Prier is short-handed, you know」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Is that so?」

name: Helena
message: 「Nanaka-chan, want to fill in?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, well, I guess I'm practically the one who drove Pasta out, so...」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis, you can't make a student work」

name: Synn
message: 「I know! I have someone in mind」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, I knew I could count on you, Synn-chan. So reliable」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah... Synn, could it be...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I'm thinking of asking Macaron」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, your little sister!」

name: Synn
message: 「For now, I'll at least talk to her about it」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, I'm counting on you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that really gonna be okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll probably work out somehow, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, if Helena-san says it's fine, I guess it's fine, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Something wrong?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, nothing at all」

name: Pasta
message: 「Unyaa...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Those Crusaders jerks really piss me off, nya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ice cream~, anyone want some~?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I won't be satisfied until I get payback, nya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Cold~, delicious~, get your ice cream~」

name: Pasta
message: 「Isn't there any good way, nya...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey there, miss」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya?」

name: Macaron
message: 「How about some ice cream?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Why the hell would I eat ice cream in this freezing cold, nya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Right~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, it's my part-time job」

name: Pasta
message: 「I guess so, nya. If it's for work, it can't be helped, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「Strawberry's fine, right?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Like I said, I don't want any, nya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Gotcha. Then I'll give you this instead」

name: Macaron
message: 「Milky Milk! Nice and body-warm」

name: Pasta
message: 「If it's free, I'll take it, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「Here you go」

name: Pasta
message: 「Gulp, gulp...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Mm. It's not bad, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「Feeling better?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You looked kind of down」

name: Pasta
message: 「Could you tell, nya...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Actually, I got fired from my part-time job today, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see... That's rough」

name: Pasta
message: 「This, that, and everything else--it's a~ll the Crusaders' fault, nya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Crusaders?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Don't tell me, did they bully you!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「It wasn't that one-sided, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「It was a super close, good fight, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If it was a fair fight, then I guess it can't be helped」

name: Macaron
message: 「Which means this kid is actually pretty strong...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I recruit them as an ally, I might be able to beat Big Brother and the others...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, wanna try showing those Crusaders a thing or two?」

name: Pasta
message: 「How are we gonna do that, nya?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll make a chance for your revenge!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Revenge, nya... Not a bad idea, nya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihehe, leave it all to the great Demon Lord Macaron!」

name: Pasta
message: 「You're a Demon Lord, nya!?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, if I had to say, I kinda only have the vibe of one in training right now, though!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Which means if I team up with this one, Bylous-nyama's wish will come true, nya?」

name: Pasta
message: 「And if I get them to beat the Crusaders too, that's two birds with one stone, nya!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Got it, nya! I'll count on you, Macaron, nya!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aww shucks, the kitty is counting on me!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta is Pasta, nya」

name: Macaron
message: 「Gotcha. Nice working with ya, Pasta!」

name: Synn
message: 「Heeeey, Macaron~」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, it's Big Brother. Nihehe...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, what's up. You sure look like you're in a good mood」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm~? It's nothing」

name: Macaron
message: 「You'll find out the hard way soon enough anyway」

name: Synn
message: 「F-Find out the hard way...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「More importantly, didn't you have some business with me, Big Brother?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right, right」

name: Synn
message: 「Want to try working a part-time job at our academy?」

name: Macaron
message: 「A part-time job?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's as a waitress in the cafeteria, though」

name: Macaron
message: 「Could it be you're in a bind?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Macaron
message: 「Do you need my help?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're pretty much the only one I can think of to rely on, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see, I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Observing Big Brother's behavior up close might not be so bad either」

name: Macaron
message: 「Got it, I'll do it for you」

name: Synn
message: 「Really? That's a huge help」

name: Macaron
message: 「I've got more mouths to feed now, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll be counting on you starting next week」

name: Macaron
message: 「Rogeeer. Leave it all to me!」
